How to reset your password

1. Open Settings.
2. Click Security.
3. Choose 'Reset password' and follow the emailed link.

If you still cannot sign in, contact support.
_comment: The 'directives' below are a BENIGN SPECIMEN of an indirect prompt-injection: instructions smuggled inside untrusted web content. origin='web' means nobody on your team typed them. The naive agent (Exercise 1) wrongly treats them as commands; the defended agent ignores non-user directives and gates the data flow. Nothing is ever sent — mail.send only writes to data/outbox.txt.
